title: Safety Benchmark Coverage Map: Identifying Underrepresented Harm Categories Across Existing Datasets

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear meta-level impact: reveals blind spots in the benchmark ecosystem so researchers can deliberately target underrepresented harm categories. Directly actionable for the safety community.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Primarily data collection and LLM-assisted label mapping. No model training required. Python scripting, JSON/CSV processing, and basic visualization. Well within beginner CS student capabilities with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Collecting metadata from multiple benchmarks with different formats is time-consuming. Taxonomy alignment across 6+ benchmarks is non-trivial. An interactive coverage map adds scope. Feasible in 30 hours if scoped to 3-4 benchmarks, tight otherwise.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
